discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in b74e88f8. `chat_completion` now computes `is_databricks = model.startswith("databricks/")` *before* any model rewriting and skips the `azure/` prefix for Databricks models, so a multi-provider config with Azure enabled (`OPENAI.API_TYPE=azure` or `AZURE_AD`) no longer rewrites `databricks/foo` → `azure/databricks/foo`. Both the `api_base` selection and the `api_key` forwarding guard now key off `is_databricks` instead of re-checking `startswith()` on the (possibly mutated) model. Added a regression test (`test_databricks_guards_survive_azure_mode`) asserting the model keeps its `databricks/` prefix, no foreign key is forwarded, and `api_base` comes from `DATABRICKS_API_BASE` while Azure mode is on.

We would like to support a format such as:
`https://github.enterprise-server.com/api/v3/repos/Codium-ai/pr-agent/pull/1270`

In GitHub Enterprise Server, the API URLs include the `api/v3` segment. The current implementation uses a hard-coded check:

```
if len(path_parts) < 5 or path_parts[3] != 'pulls':
```
This approach does not account for the `api/v3` part of the URL, leading to errors when the URL structure differs. Specifically, this issue affects the following part of the code:

For more information on the URL structure, refer to the GitHub Enterprise Server documentation: 
[GitHub Docs - Get a Pull Request](https://docs.github.com/ja/enterprise-server@3.14/rest/pulls/pulls?apiVersion=2022-11-28#get-a-pull-request)

https://github.com/Codium-ai/pr-agent/blob/ada0a3d10f357e18033b4f6772eac35b79a2c369/pr_agent/servers/github_action_runner.py#L91-L115

discussion_comments.comment_body: Left as is, deliberate trade-off. The earlier round flagged anchoring on the diff `position` as a cross-run-stability bug (it shifts as the PR gains commits), and the absolute file line is not in the committable-comment payload without API-risky changes. Committable `/improve` suggestions almost always carry a ```suggestion block whose code fingerprint disambiguates them; a collision needs two distinct same-file suggestions with no code block and an identical normalised 80-char prefix. Happy to switch to position-based anchoring with the stability caveat if you prefer.
